title: First working day and insurance start date
purpose: Ask the employee for the first working day and derive the pension fund insurance start date from it, so that the start date always falls on the 1st of a month and follows the latest first working day.

stories.title: Employee enters the first working day
stories.i_want: every new employee to state their first working day in the questionnaire, with the latest date always being the one that counts
stories.so_that: the pension fund registration has its most important input and a moved start date no longer goes unnoticed, as it did in Julia's case
stories.priority_reason: HR calls the first working day 'the number one thing' for the pension fund; a start date that was not updated caused a wrong insurance start, an unfriendly letter from the fund and weeks of fixing (Julia incident).

acceptance_criteria.title: First working day is always asked and required
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee is filling in the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.then: they are asked for their first working day as a date (DD.MM.YYYY); they cannot submit the questionnaire without it, whatever their other answers

examples.name: Any employee - first working day asked and required
Employee living abroad - first working day still asked and required

acceptance_criteria.title: First working day is recorded for the pension fund and HR
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has entered their first working day
acceptance_criteria.then: the first working day is recorded for HR, which tracks the start date, and serves as the basis of the pension fund insurance start date (see US-02.2)

acceptance_criteria.title: The latest entered date counts while the employee is filling in the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has entered a first working day and then changes it before submitting, for example because they negotiated an earlier exit with their old employer
acceptance_criteria.then: only the latest first working day is recorded; no earlier date is kept

acceptance_criteria.title: After submission only HR changes the first working day
acceptance_criteria.given: the employee has submitted the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.when: the first working day moves afterwards
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee cannot change it in the questionnaire any more; only HR can change it, the latest date replaces the earlier one without keeping a history, and the insurance start date follows the new date (see US-02.2). How HR makes the change is left to the later HR-side spec.

stories.title: Insurance start date derived from the first working day
stories.i_want: the insurance start date to be derived from the latest first working day and always to fall on the 1st of a month
stories.so_that: the employee is insured from the correct date and the fund is not given a wrong start date after the first working day has moved
stories.priority_reason: The fund requires an insurance start date on the 1st of a month; a start date that did not follow a moved first working day (Julia) led to a wrong registration and weeks of fixing.

acceptance_criteria.title: Employee is not asked for the insurance start date
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee is filling in the questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.then: they are never asked for an insurance start date; Lonio derives it from the first working day

acceptance_criteria.title: First working day on the 1st of a month
acceptance_criteria.given: the first working day is the 1st of a month
acceptance_criteria.when: Lonio derives the insurance start date
acceptance_criteria.then: insurance starts on the first working day itself

examples.name: Start on the 1st of a month

acceptance_criteria.title: First working day on any other day
acceptance_criteria.given: the first working day is any day other than the 1st of a month
acceptance_criteria.when: Lonio derives the insurance start date
acceptance_criteria.then: insurance starts on the 1st of the following month, also across a year end

examples.name: Start on the 2nd of a month
Start at the end of the year

acceptance_criteria.title: Insurance start date follows every change of the first working day
acceptance_criteria.given: an insurance start date has been derived from a first working day
acceptance_criteria.when: the first working day changes, whether by the employee before submission or by HR after submission
acceptance_criteria.then: the insurance start date is derived again from the latest first working day; a start date based on an earlier first working day never remains

acceptance_criteria.title: Insurance start date is recorded for the pension fund
acceptance_criteria.when: the insurance start date has been derived
acceptance_criteria.then: it is recorded for the pension fund's required 'Insurance start date' as DD.MM.YYYY and always falls on the 1st of a month
